system.notes:
Classified Aztechnology research subnet for black-site programme TENOCHTITLAN. IC patrols continuously; the CPU uses triple-redundant encryption on all datafiles. Two Gemini IC instances operate in the DS.

Notable data: Project specs for an unidentified bioweapon delivery mechanism, personnel files, encrypted payments to unregistered contractors. The highest-value paydata in this region of the Seattle Matrix.

nodes.name: System Access Node
nodes.description: Unlisted gateway — not visible on any public Matrix directory. Access requires a specific encrypted handshake protocol that changes weekly. No public entry path exists.

nodes.name: Sub-Processing Unit
nodes.description: Routes research data between stores and manages researcher session authentication. Continuously patrolled by IC — no idle time on this node.

nodes.name: Data Store — Research Data
nodes.description: Project TENOCHTITLAN research logs, experimental protocols, and field test results. The data here is worth millions to the right buyer — and a death sentence if Aztechnology traces the leak.

nodes.name: Data Store — Personnel & Finance
nodes.description: Researcher personnel files, contractor payment records (to untraceable accounts), and communications with entities that have no public existence. Triple-redundant encryption.

nodes.name: Central Processing Unit
nodes.description: Master control node. Manages the encryption keys for both DS nodes, IC patrol scheduling, and the emergency data-wipe protocol. A breach here triggers automatic destruction of DS-A.

triggerSteps.label: TS 1
triggerSteps.description: All three passive IC activate at once. Encryption (Passive) re-scrambles all data mid-stream. Databomb (Passive) arms on DS-A — touching it without the right decrypt code triggers immediate data destruction. Alert transmits to Aztechnology Security Operations immediately.

triggerSteps.label: TS 2
triggerSteps.description: Authenticator deploys at SAN. The handshake protocol verification is not simply a credential check — it involves a rolling cryptographic challenge that legitimate users resolve with a dedicated hardware token. A decker without this token cannot pass.

triggerSteps.label: TS 3
triggerSteps.description: First Gemini instance deploys from DS-A. Two coordinated attack programs, one pursuing, one intercepting. Overload attacks, Moderate damage each. The Geminis are pre-positioned in the research data store — they were there before the decker arrived.

triggerSteps.label: TS 4
triggerSteps.description: Second Gemini instance launches from DS-B. The decker now faces four coordinated attack instances across two separate IC programs. Coordination between Gemini instances means they cover all possible movement paths.

triggerSteps.label: TS 5
triggerSteps.description: Crippler targets the decker's MPCP directly. Each pass reduces effective MPCP by 1 unless the decker defeats it. At reduced MPCP, Hacking Pool shrinks and the situation deteriorates rapidly.

triggerSteps.label: TS 6
triggerSteps.description: Emergency data partition engaged. DS-A internal data scrambled — readable only with the research team's biometric decryption keys. A copy is simultaneously transmitted to Aztechnology's classified data vault in Tenochtitlán. The data is leaving the host.

triggerSteps.label: TS 7
triggerSteps.description: Killer IC deploys from CPU. Lethal Matrix countermeasures authorised. Hot-sim deckers are now facing Physical damage. Aztechnology does not tolerate espionage against its classified programmes.

triggerSteps.label: TS 8
triggerSteps.description: DS-A destruction protocol initiated. Research data begins secure erasure — it will be gone in 3 combat passes. CPU broadcasts emergency signal to Aztechnology's corporate response team. Whatever the runners came for is evaporating.

triggerSteps.label: TS 9
triggerSteps.description: Convergence. Complete data lockdown. GOD response. Aztechnology dispatches an extraction team — not to help the decker, but to recover whatever they took. The Pyramid's intelligence division is now aware of this intrusion.
